title: Base
description: The frame every layout is built on. Its site property declares what storefront.site may hold.

site.description: Values every page shares: storefront.site in the config

title.description: The site's name, in the header

footer.description: The line at the bottom of every page

author.description: Who the site is by: "A project by" and a link, after the footer line

location.description: Where the author is, after the link in the footer

repository.description: The project's code repository: a GitHub link in the header

sponsor.description: Where to sponsor the project: "Sponsor" among the footer's links, and "Support it" on the home page

patternDumpVersion.description: The installed Pattern Dump's version, which the docs describe: the home page's eyebrow and start row

workbenchUrl.description: Where the style guide's workbench is published, with a trailing slash (site.workbenchUrl): the footer's "Style guide" link, to the home layout until the workbench opens on a start item of its own

patternDumpReleased.description: That version's release date, as "22 November 2026", from the package's CHANGELOG.md: the home page's start row

analyticsKey.description: The Ahrefs Web Analytics key, set only by the production build (PD_ANALYTICS_KEY): partials/head loads the analytics script with it
